fact_check.claim: Mercer advice is national and counts all discretionary spending
fact_check.note: Page is generic and not campus-specific; the 'counts all discretionary spending' characterization was not confirmed in the fetched summary. Interpretive, low risk.

fact_check.note: Thread from May 2015 in the Cornell section; oldfort wrote 'unlimited allowance, $1000/mon, down to $20-50/mon' and 'few hundred/mon'. Student-voice source used only as culture, not for a hard fact.

fact_check.claim: Health insurance is separate and the 2026-27 plan price is in the linked internal guide

beats_top.query: cornell parent how much spending money should I give my student per month
